supported_intent_adapter_contract.native_orientation_policy: Preserve captured native orientations for fixed_poses (Ref*, Ref*~2 at 0 deg) and edge-seated connectors (USB1 at 0 deg west, CON1/CON2 at 90 deg east) for this selected M1 esp_prog case as a scoped M1 baseline rule, without claiming arbitrary acquired/pile footprint orientations on an input board are automatically correct.

upstream_pad_edge_metric_contract.pad_rect_definition: Axis-aligned board-space copper rect (gx - hx, gy - hy, gx + hx, gy + hy). Verified 0.0 mm max diff against kicad-route@c4af095 across all 75 esp_prog pads and 49 acquisition pads.
upstream_pad_edge_metric_contract.rect_gap_definition: dx = max(a0 - b2, b0 - a2); dy = max(a1 - b3, b1 - a3); if dx < 0 and dy < 0: return max(dx, dy) (signed negative overlap, never clamped); elif dx > 0 and dy > 0: return hypot(dx, dy); else: return max(dx, dy).
upstream_pad_edge_metric_contract.authority_separation: Metric compatibility (measuring pad_edge via signed rect_gap on pad_rect and emitting each declared subject leg) is strictly separated from limit authority: proximity[] rows with context.limit=='derived_default' remain soft solver objectives (job.rs::proximity_terms) and advisory measurements; only sourced/authored design limits act as hard release gates.

rejected_unconditional_hard_gates.reason: Owner permits flexible group shapes and notes a small bbox does not prove good placement.
Universal closer-to-own-anchor-than-every-foreign-anchor inequalities can reject legal boundary passives or interleaved interface networks.

hard_structural_and_sourced_numeric_pred.rule: Every circuit footprint on the board belongs to exactly one declared group in groups.groups[] or fixed_poses[]/shared; missing, extra, or duplicate refs fail.

Shared supply/return rails bound to captured net/part evidence (acquisition ACQ-MECH-2: GND and /V3V3; esp_prog groups.json + netlist: GND, /+3.3V, and Net-(C1-Pad1) outside its scoped USB1<->U2/C1 regulator input role) never merge blocks or generate all-to-all cross-group edges. Any multi-group net without captured rail/interface provenance is surfaced visibly in unknown_multi_group_nets rather than classified by a fixed string list.

Only explicitly sourced or authored-design numeric limits (acquisition electrical_locality obligations with authored_design_limit or datasheet_application_limit provenance, or proximity[] rows with explicit authored/datasheet authority) are hard release gates. Proximity rows carrying context.limit=='derived_default' (such as esp_prog's 8.1 mm and 2.2 mm 75th-percentile corpus defaults) remain labelled solver objectives (job.rs::proximity_terms) and advisory per-leg measurements.

source_bound_relation_predicates.definition: Minimum krt_signed_rect_gap_mm between non-aperture pads of group G and declared near target group H over shared non-rail signal nets (or scoped regulator input net Net-(C1-Pad1) for usb_in<->power). Acts as a solver objective (group_near_terms at existing GROUP_WEIGHT scale) and measured report row until design-specific numeric authority is declared.

Per-net krt_signed_rect_gap_mm between members of group G sharing an intra-group signal net (or scoped regulator input net Net-(C1-Pad1) for C1.1<->U2.2 in power), plus member-to-anchor pad_rect gap (covering C3.1<->U2.3 on /+3.3V). Used in solver objective, post-anneal member refinement, and the M1 qualitative grouping report.

required_artifacts_bound_to_candidate_sh: 1. Final native measured report (job-report.json / place metrics) recording final native coordinates, S1..S3 verdicts, advisory derived_default proximity[] legs, R1 declared near interface gaps, R2 intra-group signal/anchor link gaps, and D1/D2 diagnostics with stated limitations.
2. Annotated native board views (top/bottom/group-overlay SVG/PNG renders from the final native .kicad_pcb).

3. Independent candidate-bound engineering judgment (block_contract.judge / qualification consumer owned by agent-568) bound to board_sha256, verifying each group forms a coherent functional cluster without dispersed members.

steps: 1. Keep existing crates/placement-engine SA + quench architecture and keep proximity_terms as a soft objective for derived_default proximity rows.
2. Compile R2 intra-group signal/anchor links and R1 declared groups[].near interface signal links into Prepared (crates/placement-engine/src/job.rs) at the existing GROUP_WEIGHT scale.

3. Add constrained group-cluster translation/swap proposals during SA and a deterministic post-anneal legal member-refinement pass that proposes moving each group's non-fixed members (ordered by largest R2 link gap) into legal non-overlapping seats adjacent to their connected intra-group partner/anchor.

4. Accept refinement moves only when they preserve 0 courtyard overlap, 0 outline violations, valid edge-connector seating, and any hard sourced/authored S3 limits while strictly reducing the soft objective (R2 + R1 + derived_default proximity_terms).
